scope: Cross-model RMSNorm activation-geometry replication on Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B; not a BitNet-weight confirmation.

preregistered_rules.replication: angularH A4 + 4-bit log-radius NLL < matched Hadamard per-token absmax A4 NLL
preregistered_rules.radial_specificity: angularH A4 + 4-bit log-radius NLL + 0.25 <= min(shifted-radius NLL, constant-radius NLL)
preregistered_rules.overall: both replication and radial-specificity rules pass

verdict.cross_model_geometry: SUPPORTED IN WEAKER FORM: with the same Hadamard mixing, fixed-grid angular A4 plus the exact token-specific FP32 radius outperformed the matched Hadamard per-token dynamic A4 baseline by 0.2330 NLL on Qwen2.5-0.5B.
verdict.low_bit_radius_codec: FAILED TO REPLICATE: the 4-bit calibrated log-radius code was 2.2885 NLL worse than the matched Hadamard A4 baseline on Qwen2.5-0.5B.
verdict.radius_specificity: SUPPORTED: even the imperfect 4-bit token-specific radius was more than 1.0 NLL better than shifted or constant radius controls, so the scalar radius remains functionally informative.
verdict.advance_to_bitnet: HOLD. Do not promote the low-bit scalar-channel construction to the BitNet-weight gate yet. First determine the precision/codebook needed for the Qwen radial state (fp16/log8/log6/log5/log4 and calibration-range controls).
verdict.novelty_boundary: The data now support an architecture-sensitive separable radial state, not a universal 4-bit scalar codec.
